data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'leon', meaning 'lion'. Leoline represents a strong, courageous, and fearless girl, symbolizing the power and protection of a lioness. The name Leoline carries the meaning “Lioness” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Leoline usually hope their child will grow to embody lioness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Leoline belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lioness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Leoline total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
data.cultural_impact: The name Leoline draws inspiration from the majestic creature, the lion, which is often associated with courage, strength, and royalty in various cultures. The name Leoline reflects the power, grace, and boldness of this mighty animal, and can serve as a source of inspiration and confidence for the girl bearing this name.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian faith, the lion is symbolic of Christ and His power and courage. Leoline's name can be seen as a reminder of the strength and protection of God, and of the courage and fearlessness that a Christian ought to embody. The name can also be seen as a blessing, invoking the blessings of God's strength and courage upon the girl.
